ComfyUI 工作流程 - AnimateDiff 和 IPAdapter

你可以轻松运行这个ComfyUI AnimateDiff 和 IPAdapter 工作流程在RunComfy、ComfyUI 云，专门为ComfyUI量身定制的平台。所有必要的节点和模型均已预设并可立即使用！

另外，您还会发现很多其他很棒的工作流程ComfyUI在线服务.

此 ComfyUI 工作流程使用 AnimateDiff 进行动态调整，使用 IP-Adapter 进行基于图像的提示，从而简化动画创建，从而增强动画和图像的风格、构图和细节质量。

AnimateDiff 简介

AnimateDiff 是一款 AI 工具，可使用稳定扩散模型和运动技术将静态图像和文本转换为动画视频。它简化了动画，无需编码或特殊硬件即可访问，并且可以免费在线获取。

型号版本

AnimateDiff 支持多个版本，包括适用于 Stable Diffusion V1.5 的 AnimateDiff v1、v2、v3 和适用于 SDXL 的 AnimateDiff sdxl，允许使用不同的运动模型来制作复杂的动画。

动画长度定制

用户可以通过调整上下文批量大小来创建任意长度的动画，从而在动画持续时间和过渡方面提供灵活性。

过渡平滑度

统一上下文长度功能可确保动画片段之间的平滑过渡，使用户能够控制场景的流程。

运动动力学

AnimateDiff v2 引入了用于电影摄像机效果的运动 LoRA，为动画添加了动态视觉层。

IP适配器简介

IP-Adapter将图像提示集成到文本到图像模型中，通过结合文本和视觉输入来简化图像生成，克服纯文本提示的局限性。

v1.5 模型

  • ip-adapter_sd15：图像和文本增强的标准模型。

  • ip-adapter_sd15_light：适用于资源需求较少的任务的高效版本。

  • ip-适配器-plus_sd15：增强参考图像保真度。

  • ip-适配器-plus-face_sd15：擅长准确的面部特征。

  • ip-适配器-full-face_sd15：专注于详细的脸部交换。

  • ip-adapter_sd15_vit-G：使用 Vision Transformer BigG 进行详细特征提取。

SDXL 型号

  • ip-adapter_sdxl：复杂提示的基本模型。

  • ip-adapter_sdxl_vit-h：平衡 SDXL 功能与效率。

  • ip-适配器-plus_sdxl_vit-h：提高细节和质量。

  • ip-适配器-plus-face_sdxl_vit-h：针对面部细节准确性。

FaceID 模型

  • 人脸识别：使用 InsightFace 进行人脸嵌入。

  • 人脸识别+：通过 InsightFace 和 CLIP 增强面部特征。

  • FaceID Plus v2：升级 FaceID Plus，增强 CLIP 集成。

  • FaceID人像：支持多张人脸图像，多样化。

SDXL FaceID 型号

  • FaceID SDXL：调整 FaceID 以供 SDXL 使用。

  • FaceID Plus v2 SDXL：提供保真度更高的高清图像。

ComfyUI Workflow - AnimateDiff and IPAdapter

You can easily run thisComfyUI AnimateDiff and IPAdapter WorkflowinRunComfy, ComfyUI Cloud, a platform tailored specifically for ComfyUI. All essential nodes and models are pre-set and ready for immediate use!

Plus, you'll find plenty of other great Workflows on thisComfyUI online service.

This ComfyUI workflow streamlines animation creation using AnimateDiff for dynamic adjustments and IP-Adapter for image-based prompts, enhancing style, composition, and detail quality in animations and images.

Introduction to AnimateDiff

AnimateDiff is an AI tool that turns still images and text into animated videos using Stable Diffusion models and motion technology. It simplifies animation, making it accessible without coding or special hardware, available for free online.

Model Version

AnimateDiff supports multiple versions, including AnimateDiff v1, v2, v3 for Stable Diffusion V1.5, and AnimateDiff sdxl for SDXL, allowing for the use of different motion models for complex animations.

Animation Length Customization

Users can create animations of any length by adjusting the context batch size, offering flexibility in animation duration and transitions.

Transition Smoothness

The Uniform Context Length feature ensures smooth transitions between animation segments, giving users control over the flow of scenes.

Motion Dynamics

AnimateDiff v2 introduces motion LoRAs for cinematic camera effects, adding a dynamic visual layer to animations.

Introduction to IP-Adapter

IP-Adapter integrates image prompts into text-to-image models, simplifying image generation by combining textual and visual inputs, overcoming the limitations of text-only prompts.

v1.5 Models

  • ip-adapter_sd15: Standard model for image and text augmentation.

  • ip-adapter_sd15_light: Efficient version for less resource-demanding tasks.

  • ip-adapter-plus_sd15: Enhances reference image fidelity.

  • ip-adapter-plus-face_sd15: Specializes in accurate facial features.

  • ip-adapter-full-face_sd15: Focuses on detailed face swapping.

  • ip-adapter_sd15_vit-G: Uses Vision Transformer BigG for detailed feature extraction.

SDXL Models

  • ip-adapter_sdxl: Base model for complex prompts.

  • ip-adapter_sdxl_vit-h: Balances SDXL capabilities with efficiency.

  • ip-adapter-plus_sdxl_vit-h: Improves detail and quality.

  • ip-adapter-plus-face_sdxl_vit-h: Targets facial detail accuracy.

FaceID Models

  • FaceID: Uses InsightFace for face embeddings.

  • FaceID Plus: Enhances facial features with InsightFace and CLIP.

  • FaceID Plus v2: Upgrades FaceID Plus with enhanced CLIP integration.

  • FaceID Portrait: Supports multiple face images for variety.

SDXL FaceID Models

  • FaceID SDXL: Adapts FaceID for SDXL use.

  • FaceID Plus v2 SDXL: Provides high-definition images with improved fidelity.
